'''Kitaya Shuul''' was a young [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] native to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], in the servitude of [[Truugo]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]. She was an aspiring member of [[Freedom Flight]], a group that aimed to eliminate slavery throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. She was also a spy for her master, who used her unassuming nature to eavesdrop on enemies, which led her to be able to be a polyglot by 11 years old.
